create.name: Dr. Karen Frances McCarthy
create.bio:
Dr. Karen Frances McCarthy is an Irish Spiritualist medium, writer and academic, based between New York and Dublin. She began as a political journalist and war correspondent, reporting from Iraq and on American politics, and wrote a history of the Scots-Irish in America. After the sudden death of her partner in 2011 she turned to Spiritualism, training for several years at the Arthur Findlay College and gaining awards from the Spiritualists' National Union. She later completed a doctorate at the University of Birmingham on ghosts and re-enchantment in contemporary American fiction, and teaches spectral and speculative fiction as an adjunct at New York University.

Her teaching centres on evidential and trance mediumship, intuition, continuing bonds with loved ones in spirit, and the myths of the Tuatha Dé Danann. She offers self-paced masterclasses in mediumship, trance channelling, intuitive tarot and psychic investigation, live online demonstrations and small-group mentorships, and two courses on The Shift Network on the mystical medium and Irish sacred tradition. Her memoir Till Death Don't Us Part tells the story of her move from scepticism to mediumship, and her academic study The Re-Enchanted Ghost in Contemporary American Fiction was published by Routledge in 2026.

books.title: Till Death Don't Us Part: A True Story of Awakening to Love After Life
books.author: Karen Frances McCarthy
books.description: A memoir of a sceptical political journalist whose partner died suddenly while she was on assignment, and of the experiences that led her to Spiritualism and mediumship. It follows her move from grief and doubt to the view that consciousness continues after death.

books.title: The Re-Enchanted Ghost in Contemporary American Fiction
books.author: Karen Frances McCarthy
books.description: An academic study, published by Routledge in 2026, of ghosts and liminality in four twenty-first-century American novels, including The Lovely Bones and Lincoln in the Bardo. It reads them through ideas of postsecular culture and re-enchantment, asking what they say about consciousness and meaning.

courses.title: Journey With the Tuatha Dé Danann Through Mystical Ireland
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course on Ireland's sacred sites, pre-Celtic myth and the Tuatha Dé Danann. It covers holy wells, thin places, Ogham, divination and ancestral connection, with guided practices to repeat over time.

courses.title: Discover the Path of the Mystical Medium
courses.description: A self-paced seven-module course on trusting your inner spirit, drawing on mystics such as Rumi, Hildegard von Bingen, Meister Eckhart and Edgar Cayce. Each module has a video, audio, transcript and optional exercises.

courses.title: The Essential Mediumship Program
courses.description: An on-demand beginner-to-intermediate mediumship programme of 16 modules and over 100 lessons, with a certificate of completion. Students learn to connect, interpret and practise ethically, with optional live development circles.
courses.price: $295 USD per year (Gold) or $445 USD one time (Premium)

courses.title: Trance Channeling Masterclass
courses.description: A self-paced, practice-based masterclass of four modules and more than 50 lessons in trance mediumship. It combines the Spiritualist trance tradition with her long Zen practice to deepen altered states and inspired speaking.
courses.price: $99 USD per year (Gold) or $149 USD one time (Premium)

courses.title: Intuitive Tarot
courses.description: A ten-module on-demand masterclass that pairs traditional meanings of the Major and Minor Arcana with intuitive practice. It needs no memorising and suits all levels.
courses.price: $75 USD per year (Gold) or $125 USD one time (Premium)

courses.title: Love After Life
courses.description: A guided on-demand masterclass for anyone who has lost someone and wants to sense their presence and recognise signs. No mediumship ability is needed; the focus is on continuing bonds with loved ones in spirit.
courses.price: $125 USD per year (Gold) or $195 USD one time (Premium)

courses.title: The Psychic Detective
courses.description: A self-paced masterclass in applying intuition and remote viewing to investigations such as missing persons and unsolved cases. It includes casework, a certificate of completion and guidance on working with law enforcement.
courses.price: $295 USD per year (Gold) or $445 USD one time (Premium)

courses.title: Guided Journeys
courses.description: Three recorded guided journeys, each with a companion guidebook: The Continuity of Love, The Way of the Tuatha and Awaken Your Inner Healer. They draw on Spiritualist practice and Irish tradition and can be revisited at any time.
courses.price: $35 USD each, or $85 USD for all three

free_resources.title: Spirit Space
free_resources.description: A free online membership with guided meditations, recorded workshops and talks, and a library of short videos answering common questions about mediumship and the afterlife. Access is by free sign-up with an email address.
